cases.input: One dataset version is released as CSV and Parquet.
cases.expect: Both distributions keep separate immutable bytes and digests while sharing the same time-scoped pinned contract.

cases.input: A compatible contract successor is issued while dataset bytes do not change.
cases.expect: A timestamped conformance assertion is appended for the exact successor; the prior assertion and dataset version remain immutable.

cases.input: Dataset content changes under the same structural schema.
cases.expect: A successor dataset version records predecessor and provenance and receives a scoped compatibility outcome covering content semantics.

cases.input: A catalogue record is revised for the abstract dataset.
cases.expect: The record changes without minting or replacing dataset identity.

cases.input: A designated critical field binds a governed term and versioned value domain.
cases.expect: The field is accepted while designation policy remains external.

cases.input: A distribution references a signed manifest containing algorithm and digest.
cases.expect: Fixity is accepted and remains immutable.

cases.input: A published Parquet distribution has neither digest nor signed digest manifest.
cases.expect: The release is rejected.

cases.input: CSV bytes change and overwrite the checksum under the same distribution identity.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; issue a new distribution or dataset version.

cases.input: CSV and Parquet distributions at one assertion time bind different contract versions.
cases.expect: The release is rejected as incoherent.

cases.input: A dataset version resolves a mutable latest-contract link.
cases.expect: Conformance is rejected as unpinned and non-historical.

cases.input: A transitive compatibility result omits one predecessor baseline.
cases.expect: The outcome is incomplete and cannot drive breaking status.

cases.input: Compatibility mode NONE is used without an accountable exception.
cases.expect: Publication is rejected.

cases.input: A successor contract is published with a mode but no outcome.
cases.expect: Publication is rejected.

cases.input: The dataset is marked non-breaking while the scoped outcome is breaking.
cases.expect: The independent flag is rejected and derived value wins.

cases.input: A critical code value is retired but only structural schema compatibility is assessed.
cases.expect: The outcome is insufficient because governed semantic and value-domain changes are in scope.

cases.input: A successor dataset version has no predecessor or provenance assertions.
cases.expect: Version issuance is rejected.

cases.input: A catalogue-record identifier is used as dataset master identity.
cases.expect: The identity collapse is rejected.

cases.input: The dataset profile masters a quality rule and assessment run.
cases.expect: The duplicate master is rejected; only references or summaries are allowed.

cases.input: An ODCS dataProduct element mints a second product identity inside EM-DAT-01.
cases.expect: The duplicate is rejected and must reference WM-DAT-008 or EM-DAT-02 authority.

cases.input: A DatasetSchemaContract root is minted for one dataset and contract pair.
cases.expect: The duplicate aggregate and runtime identity are rejected.
